entries.text: Director Clavell?
entries.label: team_0115_select_01

entries.text: Clive?
entries.label: team_0115_select_02

entries.text: Oh, come on. The name’s Clive, remember?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_02a

entries.text: Yup! That’s my name.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_02b

entries.text: Actually...no. It’s time for me to bring this little\nperformance to an end.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_03

entries.text: Allow me to reveal my true identity![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_04

entries.text: Ha-hah![VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_05

entries.text: I do apologize for deceiving you with my disguise.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_06

entries.text: In truth, the boy you knew as Clive was none\nother than the director of Naranja Academy...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_07a

entries.text: In truth, the boy you knew as Clive was none\nother than the director of Uva Academy...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_07b

entries.text: Mr. Clavell![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_08

entries.text: N-no way!
entries.label: team_0115_select_03

entries.text: I already knew that
entries.label: team_0115_select_04

entries.text: Yes, this must be quite the shock! My disguise\nwas perfect, after all.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_09a

entries.text:
What?! But my disguise was perfect!\c
Although, now that I think about it...I did neglect
to keep up my youthful act on a few occasions.
That must have been what gave me away.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_09b

entries.text: Regardless, there is still one more astonishing\ntruth I must reveal to you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_10

entries.text: The true identity of Cassiopeia, the big boss of\nTeam Star...was ME all along!!![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_11

entries.text: For real?!
entries.label: team_0115_select_05

entries.text: That’s impossible
entries.label: team_0115_select_06

entries.text: Honest to goodness![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_12

entries.text:
When you heard Cassiopeia over the phone,
that was actually a prerecorded voice.\c
I pulled it off using, er...you know, one of those...
high-tech gizmos! Oh yes, it was very clever![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_13

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Now
you
know
I’m
the
big
boss!
That
means
there
is
just
one
thing
left
to do![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_14

entries.text: Face me in one final showdown to decide it all![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_15

entries.text: Well now, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_16

entries.text: It seems you have grown quite splendidly over\nthe course of your Treasure Hunt.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_17

entries.text: And here, once again, I must apologize—[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_18

entries.text: I am not actually Cassiopeia.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_19

entries.text: Though Clive and myself being the same person\nwas no lie, mind you...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_20

entries.text: Cassiopeia’s true identity remains hidden.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_21

entries.text: But I believe I can hazard a guess as to who\nthey may be.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_22

entries.text: That is why I sought to spare you from having to\nconfront them in battle.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_23

entries.text: Their sorrows...should not be yours to bear.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_24

entries.text: However, Cassiopeia has settled on a course of\naction and is determined to see it through.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_25

entries.text: I do not imagine any ordinary student could hope\nto stand against them and win.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_26

entries.text: So, I challenged you to a battle to test your skill.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_27

entries.text: If you had lost, it would have fallen to me to\nbring down Cassiopeia. Such was my resolve.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_28

entries.text: But it turns out you are as strong as you are kind.\nIf anyone has a chance at saving that poor child,\r\nit is surely you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_29

entries.text: As an educator it shames me to burden one of\nmy students with such a task...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_30

entries.text: But please...defeat Cassiopeia! Take on the big\nboss of Team Star and win![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_31

entries.text: Yes, sir!
entries.label: team_0115_select_07

entries.text: Leave it to me!
entries.label: team_0115_select_08

entries.text: Thank you, from the bottom of my heart. I leave\nthis in your hands.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_32

entries.text: You there! What do you think you’re doing?![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_01

entries.text: Ah! Ms. Tyme, a pleasure to see you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_33

entries.text: It’s no pleasure at all, Mr. Clavell![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_02

entries.text: I come here to investigate reports of an illicit\nbattle on school grounds, and what do I find?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_03

entries.text: Why, the director of the academy himself!\nFacing off against one of our students, no less!\r\nWhat were you thinking?![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_04

entries.text: Ah, no, if I could just explain. You see, it is a\nrather sad tale...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_34

entries.text: Oh, spare me! Your excuses reek worse than a\nStunky’s behind![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_05

entries.text: A Stunky’s b-b-behind?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_35

entries.text: Ahem![VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_36

entries.text: Remember—the big boss asked us to meet them\nin the schoolyard after dark.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_37

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I am counting on you, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_38

entries.text:
You’ll write a letter of apology to the students
and faculty at once!\c
And I’ll be reporting this to the chairwoman of
the school board, make no mistake![VAR 0x0114(0025)]
entries.label: team_0115_math_06

entries.text: Good gracious, no! A-anything but that,\nI implore you...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: team_0115_nelke_39
